messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to match the movement shown in the motion reference video. Follow the reference movement precisely while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and facial expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to her head, then turns to a side profile while posing with a hand near her face.","camera":"Static, low-angle full-body shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A blue one-piece romper with a white abstract pattern, long sleeves, and pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, tousled hair that is later gathered into a small ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, featuring a Ferris wheel on the left, a carousel structure with lights on the right, and a small ticket booth in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character no longer walks. She now stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to her head, places the other hand on her hip, then turns into a side profile while posing with a hand near her face, closely matching the reference motion. The amusement park scene, lighting, and static camera remain essentially unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's walking action with the motion reference's pose sequence, while preserving the character's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved exactly, since she is mostly seen from behind or in profile.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears gathered into a small ponytail in later frames, whereas the source showed short tousled hair without a visible ponytail.
